sentence: This project builds a label-free microscopy imaging system, powered by AI, to help diagnose thyroid cancer and lymph node metastasis.
This project sets up shared imaging and cell analysis instruments, such as fluorescence and Raman microscopy, for research on molecular pathogenesis.
This project builds hydrogels that mimic bone formation to test how matrix density and mineralization affect stem cell differentiation and bone regeneration.
This project builds reagents and delivery tools that use gene therapy to repair genetic defects in cells lining the airways.
This project studies gene expression in mouse models of late-onset disease using bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing.
This project tests whether transgenic T cells that target melanoma-associated antigens can eliminate lesions in lymphangioleiomyomatosis.
This project studies how a fly transcription factor and its partner proteins work together in the eye.
This project studies how gastrin-releasing peptide neurons in the gustatory cortex connect taste with hunger and thirst.
This project supports multi-disciplinary research on environmental health during vulnerable periods of development and in highly exposed populations.
This project tests whether drugs that activate the melanocortin 4 receptor can stimulate breathing in mice with obesity hypoventilation and sleep apnea.
This project studies how electrical activity in the human stomach starts and spreads to drive gastric motility.
This project studies how Enterovirus D68 infects and damages motor neurons in acute flaccid myelitis.
This project studies how kidney T cells with high levels of one protein relate to inflammation in lupus nephritis.
This project studies how gut microbiota and the bile acids they make affect Clostridioides difficile infection in inflammatory bowel disease.
This project studies how chromatin remodeling and histone modifications work to control genes.
This project studies how mutations in a gene that regulates neurodevelopment change gene regulation and cells grown from induced pluripotent stem cells.
This project studies how fat stores tell the body about nutrient state through hormones called adipokines.
This project studies how the immune system forms memory against tumors and how cancer disrupts this process.
This project develops a method that reads cell-free RNA in blood and urine without favoring short or long RNAs.
This project organizes data from many studies and uses machine learning to find subtypes of heart failure with preserved ejection fraction.
